basic_details.job_title: RBRNES PG College Computer Science Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | computer science faculty: MCA / M.Sc. / M.Tech. (CS). Preference will be given to candidates with M.Sc. IT if candidates with M.Sc. (IT) are not available.

salary_details.details: The notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a merit list prepared according to the directives of Higher Education based on UGC parameters.
how_to_apply: Review the official notification and verify your eligibility for the Computer Science Faculty post.
Prepare your bio-data detailing your educational qualifications and experience.
Compile attested copies of all required documents and certificates.
Submit your application along with your bio-data either by post or by visiting the college in person.
Ensure the application reaches the office of the Principal, Government Ram Ratan Vyas Postgraduate (Leading) College, Jashpurnagar, District-Jashpur (Chhattisgarh) on or before 14 October 2026.
important_instructions: Applications sent via email or WhatsApp will not be accepted. This appointment is completely temporary (guest faculty basis). Services of the guest faculty will not form the basis for future regularization nor will they be entitled to claim preferential treatment. Applicants must clearly mention their mobile number and email ID in the application due to short notice and time constraints. Late applications received after 14 October 2026 will not be considered. Incomplete applications or those without mandatory contact details will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at RBRNES PG College?
faq.answer: The college has invited offline applications for 1 Computer Science Faculty position under a self-financing scheme for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Computer Science Faculty post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MCA, M.Sc., or M.Tech. in Computer Science, with preference given to M.Sc. IT if specific candidates are not available.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or remuneration offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a maximum fixed honorarium of Rs. 15,000 per month.
